translation.tgt: You should see a doctor, it could be jaundice.

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi, wa ko problema, dili lang kini ka-scratch lang.
translation.tgt: No, I'm fine, it's just a scratch.

translation.tgt: The fishermen just row their large fishing boat together

translation.tgt: My family is in the village.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili ku magangkap paggakus ang iyang hawak
translation.tgt: I can’t manage to get my arms around her waist

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ngano dili? Aduna bay espesipikong rason nga dili kami makakuha og mga litrato?
translation.tgt: Why not? Is there a specific reason we can't take photos?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kining parti sa tabla mau ang gabsun
translation.tgt: Saw this part of the wood

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kanang swilduha makaharuhay na giyud ning atung pagpuyo
translation.tgt: With that salary we can live a life of ease and comfort

translation.src: [STREET] Giiyan ko, salamat sa pag-abot sa imo.
translation.tgt: That's a relief, thank you for letting me know.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Gamit ug tisas kun maghaknut na ang taku
translation.tgt: Use chalk when the cue gets sticky

translation.src: [FORMAL] Magkinahanglan ka ug panahon sa pag-ayo.
translation.tgt: You will need time to heal.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Aduna bay mga sunog sa kalasangan sa dapit?
translation.tgt: Have there been forest fires in the area?

translation.src: [STREET] Asa ta makapalit sa panis ug grains?
translation.tgt: Where can we purchase bread and grains?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Hastang nakahibuk sa mga tawung mitabo sa Papa
translation.tgt: My, how the crowd swarmed to meet the Pope

translation.src: [STREET] Oo, dili man nako mahimuyyo sa Ininglis. Kanus-a man nako ma-ugaling sa imoha?
translation.tgt: Yes, I speak English fluently. How can I help you?

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, unsaon nang kadiyot nimo?
translation.tgt: What is your rank / title?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ngano nga dili nimo mahimo kini sa imong kaugalingon?
translation.tgt: Why can't you do it yourself?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nahinuklug ang mga tawu sa masulub-ung balita
translation.tgt: The people were stricken with grief at the sad news

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nganong gusto ka moadto sa akong payag? Pribado kini.
translation.tgt: Why do you want to go to my cabin? It's private.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ayaw kug hurawa kay magkasayup hinuun
translation.tgt: Don’t hurry me because I’ll only botch it up

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili, kini usa ka mahagiton nga tuig.
translation.tgt: No, this has been a challenging year.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nganong nagpakabana ka kon asa ko mag-alagad?
translation.tgt: Why do you care where I serve?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Laing sesyon ang mahitabo unya karong adlawa.
translation.tgt: Another session will take place later today.

translation.src: [STREET] Kinsa kaha ang panginahanglan mo sa akong pangalan sa pamilya?
translation.tgt: Why do you need to know my family name?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nahilus ang akung pagkuput sa sanga
translation.tgt: I lost my hold on the branch

translation.src: [FORMAL] Akuy muhukad ining mga butang sa iyang malita
translation.tgt: I’ll take the things out of his suitcase

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, tabangi ko pagsakay sa eroplano.
translation.tgt: Of course, I'll assist in moving the airplane.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, wa ka kaila na gibuho.
translation.tgt: No, I haven't had any broken bones.,

translation.src: [FORMAL] Maaliwarus lang ang balay kun magdagandagan ang mga bata
translation.tgt: The house will just be in commotion if the children keep running about

translation.src: [FORMAL] Pasayloa, dili kami makahatag kanimo og ___ ka litro nga tubig nga mainom.
translation.tgt: Sorry, we are unable to provide you with ___ liters of potable water.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Manday nagtirnu na ku, miulan na nuun
translation.tgt: Just the one time I wear a suit, it starts to rain

translation.src: [FORMAL] Wa ku gubini sa imung pag-istar
translation.tgt: I don’t consider your visit an annoyance

translation.src: [FORMAL] Diay ba? Ingun kug nabayran ku na na
translation.tgt: Is that so? I thought I had already paid it

translation.src: [FORMAL] Hangin ang mibunggo sa mga sanga sa kahuy
translation.tgt: The wind broke the branches off of the tree

translation.src: [STREET] Wa ko kalabay ug ipabihag ang klase ni fuel nato.
translation.tgt: I'm not at liberty to disclose the amount of fuel we have.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nagkinahanglan kami og daghang mga manggugubat. Dili paigo ang usa ka libo.
translation.tgt: We need more warriors. One thousand is not enough.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nganung nagguray-ut gud nang dagway mu? Gibwagan ka?
translation.tgt: Why do you look so haggard? Did your girl friend break up with you?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili makig-away o makiglalis sa bisan kinsa nga drayber tungod sa posisyon sa convoy.
translation.tgt: No fighting or arguing with any other driver over position in convoy.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili, ang proseso sa sedimentation wala gigamit alang sa pagtambal sa tubig.
translation.tgt: No, sedimentation process is not used for the water treatment.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kadtung nalumus dinhi abang kunu tu sa ingkantu
translation.tgt: The man who drowned here is said to have been the rent collected by the supernatural spirit

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kada bula makada kug siyin kilus
translation.tgt: I can take one hundred kilograms on my shoulders at one time

translation.src: [FORMAL] Mihukyaw ang akung ginhawaan pagkakita nako sa batang naligsan
translation.tgt: I was overcome with horror when I saw the child run over by a truck

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili nako makaya nga magkasakit karon, makapangita ba kami og mas dali nga tambal?
translation.tgt: I can't afford to get sick now, can we find a quicker remedy?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nakadawat mig balibad niya nga di siya makaanhi
translation.tgt: We already received his excuse that he couldn’t come

translation.src: [FORMAL] Muhangup ang bata nako inig-abut nako sa balay
translation.tgt: The child greets me with joy as soon as I get home

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili madanglas ang paril kay dangug
translation.tgt: You can’t climb up that wall because it’s slippery

translation.src: [FORMAL] Hinutdanay giyud sa puhunan nang ilang sugal
translation.tgt: They gamble until one of them runs out of money

translation.src: [FORMAL] Balakun (ibalak) nako ang ultimu adiyus ni Risal
translation.tgt: I am going to recite Rizal’s ‘Last Farewell’

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nakabayad na ku sa mga utang. Makaginhawa na ta
translation.tgt: I’ve paid the debts. Now we can breathe

translation.src: [FORMAL] Salamat sa pag-atiman sa akong anak.
translation.tgt: Thank you for taking care of my child.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili kini ang akong gusto. Dili igo ang napulog tulo.
translation.tgt: This is not what I wanted. Thirteen is not enough.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Iya ra intawun di manakud, intirnasyunal kaayu nang bayhana
translation.tgt: God forbid it happen to anyone else. That woman has children from all different fathers

translation.src: [FORMAL] Bugkusi ug panyo ang imung samad
translation.tgt: Tie a handkerchief around your wound

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nahianhi lang mi dinhi sa amung libutlibut
translation.tgt: In our wandering, we wound up here

translation.src: [FORMAL] Aduna ka bay sakit sa mga nag-sunod?
translation.tgt: Do you have any of the following diseases?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Mabakang (mubakang) ang bata kun punayan ug tambid
translation.tgt: A child becomes bowlegged if he is always carried astride

translation.src: [STREET] Piskot, dili, wa TV station dinhi sa area nato, ambi kami sa nasudhanon TV stations sa mga programa ug balita.
translation.tgt: No, there is no TV station in this area. We rely on national TV stations for programs and news.

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi ka kuno may sakit ka sa pagdudumili?
translation.tgt: Do you have any pain with urination?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nabugto ang pisi kay gabuk na diay
translation.tgt: The rope broke because it was already rotten

translation.src: [FORMAL] Giagup-up (giagup-upan) na ang sud-ang hikalimtan
translation.tgt: The food they forgot about got all moldy

translation.src: [STREET] Wala, daghan diha diha.
translation.tgt: No, it's not between those two.

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, dili na mi kailangan ug tabang sa paggawa sa kalsada diri sa lugar.
translation.tgt: We don't need any assistance in building roads at this location.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nabatian na ba nimo kining sakita sa dughan kaniadto?
translation.tgt: Have you had this type of chest pain before?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Alkuntrahig pintul dinhing pikasa ug paknga ug martilyu sa pikas
translation.tgt: Put a piece of wood on this side to absorb the blow and strike it with a hammer on the other side

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kandalaw ang bansag sa amung baryu kaniadtu
translation.tgt: Our village was formerly named Kandalaw

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang hulikab sa bukubuku nga gilapsan sa bala ingun sa palad
translation.tgt: The hole in the back where the bullet emerged was as big as the palm of the hand

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang aksidente nahitabo sa intersection sa Main Street ug Center Avenue.
translation.tgt: The accident happened on the intersection of Main Street and Center Avenue.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Makapahupay kana! Salamat sa pag-atiman sa akong anak.
translation.tgt: That's a relief! Thank you for taking care of my child.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili nako ibutyag ang pagkatawo sa akong amo.
translation.tgt: I would rather not disclose the identity of my employer.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang iyang nigusyu nagkadal-us sa kaputu
translation.tgt: His business gradually slipped into bankruptcy

translation.src: [FORMAL] Okay ra ko, wala ko kabalo nganong nakaingon ka ana.
translation.tgt: I'm fine, I don't know why you say that.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Inigkahuman sa iliksiyun sugdan dayun ang ihap
translation.tgt: Right after the voting the canvassing of ballots will take place. †

translation.src: [FORMAL] Muhawa (mupahawa) ku ining balaya kay buysit
translation.tgt: I’ll leave this house because it brings us bad luck

translation.src: [STREET] Nag-ambot! Moadto ko sa silangan.
translation.tgt: Got it! I will head towards the east.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Danglasan aku sa mga bata ig-abut nako
translation.tgt: The children clamber all over me when I get home

translation.src: [FORMAL] Dili, kini sama sa usa ka dull nga kasakit.
translation.tgt: No, it's more like a dull ache.

translation.src: [STREET] Ang amo ni sa Kapitan John Smith.
translation.tgt: My supervisor is Captain John Smith.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Bagnut siya sa ilang pamilya. Dili siya mutabang sa buluhatun
translation.tgt: He is a parasite in their family. He doesn’t help with the chores

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kun gibat-us ka ligdan ug gantang
translation.tgt: If you feel discomfort from overeating, roll a quart jar over your stomach

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kinahaanglan ako kaang tagaan ug tambal sa imong kibut
translation.tgt: I must give you a suppository into your rectum.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Ang mga lalaki niini nga komunidad kugihan
translation.tgt: The men in this community are hardworking

translation.src: [FORMAL] Nagpangandak siya nga musukul siya nimu bisan anus-a
translation.tgt: He was boasting that he would stand up to you any time

translation.src: [FORMAL] Gastuha ang imung kusug sa maayung katuyuan
translation.tgt: Use your strength for good purposes

translation.src: [FORMAL] Mihunggal ang basiyung kahun nga nahulug
translation.tgt: The empty box that fell went bonk

translation.src: [FORMAL] Mabasag ang tingug kun bayungbayung na
translation.tgt: When you reach adolescence, your voice cracks

translation.src: [FORMAL] Pila ka tawo ang nag-operate sa sistema?
translation.tgt: How many people operate the system?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Kung dili matambalan, kini mahimong mosangpot sa impeksyon ug uban pang mga komplikasyon.
translation.tgt: If left untreated, it can lead to infection and other complications.

translation.src: [FORMAL] Tuhi, muartiarti pa na siyag pamalayi bisag dugay na nilang puyo
translation.tgt: Phooey, he puts on a show of asking for the girl’s hand, as if they hadn’t already been living together for a long time

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, dili ka magpabilin uy, mayo nito poison.
translation.tgt: Be careful! The bottle is filled with poison.

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, saan mo makig-umaan? Pwede maluto ang imong address.
translation.tgt: Where do you live? / What is your address?

translation.src: [FORMAL] Importante ang transparency. Dili ba kami makahatag pipila ka kinatibuk-ang kasayuran aron masiguro ang pagsalig sa publiko?
translation.tgt: Transparency is vital. Can't we provide some general information to ensure public trust?

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi, ang property kana daghan kaayo ka dili nag-ano, ubos-an ug nagkabahog pa ug mga unta.
translation.tgt: The property is in a dilapidated state, neglected and overgrown with weeds.

translation.src: [STREET] Wahay, wa ko ang akong mga line sa fishing.
translation.tgt: No, I don't have my fishing lines out.

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi, dili, mas dali ko lang makahimo ang daan ug dili pa man siya.
translation.tgt: No, I think I know the way better than her.

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, importante nga i-save ug i-protehi ang katawhan nato.
translation.tgt: We need to ensure the safety and protection of our people.

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, magandang suhestiyon, mag-ingon lang ko diri nako sa kaso ug alcohol.
translation.tgt: Good advice. I will make sure to avoid alcohol when taking medicine.

translation.src: [STREET] Naa, giirogot ko. Pwede pa ba ko imo pagsabot?
translation.tgt: No, I'm fine. Why are you asking?

translation.src: [STREET] Wa pa'g problema. Salamat sa oras, bai.
translation.tgt: No worries. Thank you for your time.

translation.src: [STREET] Wa, di ko magtindog sa mga kamot.
translation.tgt: No, I will not raise my hands.

translation.src: [STREET] Gawas ko'y kugos sa arm mo ug gamay para sa gamot.
translation.tgt: I am going to put a needle in your arm to give you medication.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, unsay adlaw ang nahimak nimo ug fever?
translation.tgt: For how many days have you had a fever?

translation.src: [STREET] Dugaya uy, naa ba sa kadaghan nimo pag-serve sa Navy?
translation.tgt: That's great! How long have you been in the Navy?

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, nagmalipay ko kay naka-akong buhok, daku ra ka bayot ni.
translation.tgt: I love how my hair looks, it's so shiny.

translation.src: [STREET] Oks, ang sitwasyon daw severe, kagamay kaayo unya kailangan muha nato gihapong gihapon ang isyu.
translation.tgt: Yes, the situation is severe. We need to take immediate action to address the issue at hand.

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi ang mga lokal, biasado daw gihapon kaayo ug unreliable.
translation.tgt: I don't trust the local authorities, they are biased and unreliable.

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, dili man siya gusto mag-respond sa imong tan-awon.
translation.tgt: He does not want to answer that question.

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, dili na ko magtabang sa imo ha.
translation.tgt: I don't need your help right now.

translation.src: [STREET] Pwede mo ba pagtang-ong saon sa imong pagkabasa
translation.tgt: Show me where it hurts worst.

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, dili kasing-kasing nako. Unya, unsaon kaha unta ang gi-allow?
translation.tgt: I thought it would make a great video. Why is it not allowed?

translation.src: [STREET] Dili ko mubalik sa pag-awit, makasakit uy.
translation.tgt: I don't want to look down, it's scary!

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, pwede na unya hinayon? Maka-bwisit.
translation.tgt: Can we skip it this time? It's painful.

translation.src: [STREET] Dili, daghang piso, kung unsa gyud ka gusto.
translation.tgt: I don't want thirty. I need something else.

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi, duna na ko paghunahuna ha, makasakpan lang ko.
translation.tgt: Understood, I'll wait until the surgery.

translation.src: [STREET] Uy, hingtunggan na ba sila? Dugaya nato og dali, nag-wait na ta.
translation.tgt: It's about time they arrive. We've been waiting for too long.

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, tubag lang og gas, usa sa uban gihatag sa kusina dinhi. Nagamit sa pagpanid og dako ug madugay ug dali sa pagkontrol.
translation.tgt: Yes, gas is a commonly used fuel for cooking in this area. It provides a consistent flame and is easy to control.

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, wa ba, bawal na nako sa agi! Pwede na tay nag-abot kana?
translation.tgt: No, I'm afraid of needles! Can we find another way?

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi, gusto ko mag-dumahe sa umaga, pwede ba unya ta sa uban?
translation.tgt: I prefer sleeping in, can we do it later?

translation.src: [STREET] Wala ko kamo sa diarrhea uy, dili ba kana kinahanglan ug pangmedisina unta if naka-experience ko?
translation.tgt: I don't have diarrhea. Do I need medical attention if I experience it?

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, gipahubog ba nimo ang numero? Nagkalimot ko sa iya.
translation.tgt: Can you repeat the number? I didn't catch it.

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, napiliton ta sa mina! Mga bukid ug kamatayon!
translation.tgt: We're stuck in the minefield! It's a death trap.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, dili ka lang bisag tapos diri taka sa nose, kinsa way kaha ug tukod.
translation.tgt: Touch your finger to your nose like this.

translation.src: [STREET] Piskot, dawaton nako sa wala na karon, mukha na gyud kahaon.
translation.tgt: That's too long, can we try it for a shorter time?

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, wa ko mag-reveal kung kinsa ang amo nako.
translation.tgt: I can't reveal the identity of my supervisor.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, adlaw na nagdugay sa mi last period.
translation.tgt: My last period was two weeks ago.

translation.src: [STREET] Wala ko gusto karon, ambakon kog gihapon.
translation.tgt: I don't want to do it.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, nadayag man ko kung na-ruptura ang bunga ka?
translation.tgt: Have you ever had any broken bones?

translation.src: [STREET] Ako ka nindot, pasugo nako ang dokumento ug ipasulat ko kana.
translation.tgt: I understand. Please give me the document and I will fill it out.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, dili kog nagan-an sa mga hayop nanggataw kag parasites.
translation.tgt: I don't believe the animals are infected with parasites.,

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, ato panguna ang minimum ___.
translation.tgt: Sure, we will provide the minimum ___.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, oks, akong giatim, dili ko moalis diri sa room.
translation.tgt: Got it, I'll stay in this room.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, kusog lang ang train sa akong tikig.
translation.tgt: No, I missed the train by a few seconds.

translation.src: [STREET] Giatay, wa ko ammo, kol!
translation.tgt: No, we do not have any ammunition.

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, wa koy sure ug sa midnight uy, makakabwisit jud ko.
translation.tgt: No, I feel scared during midnight.

translation.src: [STREET] Yadz, kay diha ba ug komunikasyon sa militar?
translation.tgt: But what if there's no communication with the military?

translation.src: [STREET] Siyagit lang kining adlaw, kaya baog lang ang oras ni!
translation.tgt: It just started today, so only a few hours.

translation.src: [STREET] Makita sa sentro sa bayan ang plaza, ambot?
translation.tgt: You can find the square in the center of town.

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, bai, kinsa motawo sa bag-ong kaso, dugaya na ba kay?
translation.tgt: Why didn't you take this matter seriously from the beginning? It's too late now.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, maghunahuna nako kanang sa akong labi.
translation.tgt: Okay, I will inhale through my mouth.

translation.src: [STREET] Oo, ang anak nako nihukay sa umaga.
translation.tgt: Yes, my child passed urine this morning.

translation.src: [STREET] Pulo-anon kaon sa ilahud, dako na kaha ang pwesto sa pag-awtoguid.
translation.tgt: The control room is on the lower deck, I can guide you there.

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi, may public announcement ta ba?
translation.tgt: Do you have a public announcement system?

translation.src: [STREET] Wa, dagan pa unta ko iga.
translation.tgt: No, it will take me a few seconds more.

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, tabigi ko bisan una una ug isyu sa semana, salamat sa pagtabang.
translation.tgt: Okay, I'll make sure to come back in one week. Thank you for your help.

translation.src: [STREET] Senyor Sarnoso, kana dili gyung yata.
translation.tgt: No, that's not right. It should be 'Senyor Sarnoso / Senyor Sargento'.

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, nagapakita akong giabay aron makawala sa allergens, pero dugaya nako ug makasakto uy.
translation.tgt: I do my best to avoid allergens, but sometimes it's difficult.

translation.src: [STREET] Bai, unsa pa kaayo ka mga tulhugan sa duol?
translation.tgt: How many water wells do you have in this area?

translation.src: [STREET] Dili ko magawas kung wala sa pangalan sa mga bilihe.
translation.tgt: I cannot proceed without the name of the goods.

translation.src: [STREET] Nag-una man si adunay laban, kami ka giatay, daghan man problema kami.
translation.tgt: The enemy overpowered us. We are in great danger.

translation.src: [STREET] Piskot, ang akong kaong gikapoy kay wet ra ka bay. Makakasakit kaayo kaw uy.
translation.tgt: My clothes are soaking wet. This is so inconvenient.

translation.src: [STREET] Dili nato may veterinariyanon sa kalambuan. Mablis mahuman nato ang maayong pangandam sa kalipayon nato.
translation.tgt: We don't have a veterinarian nearby. It's difficult to get proper medical care for our animals.

translation.src: [STREET] Tol, wa, wala tay storm. Ambi, gusto ko mahibalo sa bag-ong ulan sa safe lang.
translation.tgt: No, there is no storm. I hope to witness a storm someday from a safe location.

translation.src: [STREET] Oo, diri gyapon ang husto! Sabado uy!
translation.tgt: Yes, that is the right day! It's Saturday!

translation.src: [STREET] Wa mopaabot ka sa tawo karon, dili sila kabalo sa among wika.
translation.tgt: There is no one available who speaks this language.,

translation.src: [STREET] Ambi, kung unsaon ang problema nimo, dili pa mo ang trabaho ni doktor ug si therapist.
translation.tgt: You should seek professional help for that.

translation.src: [STREET] Piskot, gi-abot nako, wa ko makapag-abot.
translation.tgt: We are here to help you.,

translation.src: [STREET] Kol, wa man uy, kaila man dili kuanon pa!
translation.tgt: No, that's wrong! That was not yesterday!

translation.src: [STREET] Daghan ka adlaw wa ko makapakita kaog, maka-ambak.
translation.tgt: I haven't had a bowel movement for 2 days and it's uncomfortable.

translation.src: [STREET] Ang mga sundalo sa kwartilya gud disciplined kaayo ug professional.
translation.tgt: The soldiers in the barracks are disciplined and professional.
